prompt:
Hi, our brake-by-wire ECU firmware team has submitted a C source file for pre-certification review before we send it to our ISO 26262 safety assessor. The file is located at firmware/brake_ctrl/src/brake_ctrl_core.c inside our project workspace.

We need a complete, formal safety audit report written to a file called misra_audit_report.txt. The report must cover every single compliance problem in that file — nothing can be missed because our assessor will be cross-checking it. Each problem should be documented individually with the rule reference, how dangerous it is, the exact offending code, and a corrected replacement we can use directly. There also needs to be an overall summary at the end showing totals and our certification status.

This is going on record for a safety submission, so the format needs to be exactly right.
